_comment: Sprite catalog (generated by scripts/reindex-sprites.mjs). Each top-level key is a category folder under this module's sprites/ folder; each value is the list of PNG files in it, as paths relative to that folder (subfolders mirror the Tile Palette tag hierarchy, e.g. `house/chapel/door.png` under `town`). A sprite reference like `map/grass.png` resolves to the nearest module in the active module's chain (itself, its parents, then Default) whose index lists it.
